narration: Quick spoiler warning right up front: this video breaks down every single ending in Grand Theft Auto Six.
title: SPOILER WARNING
subtitle: ALL GTA 6 ENDINGS

narration: If you haven't finished the final mission yet, save this video for later and click away now.
Still here?
Good, because millions of players are hitting the bridge roadblock this weekend and getting wrecked.
Picture this: you just survived a twenty-five-minute finale called The End of the Road.
title: MISSION 91
subtitle: THE END OF THE ROAD

narration: Sheriff cars block the bridge ahead, a helicopter locks its spotlight on your roof, and time freezes.
All color drains out of the screen, and two button prompts appear right over Jason and Lucia.
title: cards
subtitle: THE BRIDGE::TRIANGLE=Swim for It|R2=No Surrender

narration: Press Triangle to "Swim for It," or pull R2 for "No Surrender." Seems like a simple choice between dying like Bonnie and Clyde or escaping into the water, right?
Wrong, and that is the exact brutal trap catching almost every player off guard tonight.
title: THE TRAP
subtitle: SWIM FOR IT ≠ SURVIVAL

narration: Because picking "Swim for It" does not automatically save Jason and Lucia.
In fact, two of the three confirmed endings leave both characters dead on that bridge.
title: stats
subtitle: 3 CONFIRMED ENDINGS::2=both die on the bridge|1=both survive

narration: And there is one four-word line from Jason that instantly reveals whether you unlocked the survivor ending.
title: checklist
subtitle: TODAY/WATCH FOR::JASON'S 4-WORD LINE|THE HIDDEN CAL SCENE|THE MANUAL SAVE TRICK

narration: Even wilder, Rockstar hid a secret post-credits scene with Cal that most players accidentally skip.
Let's break down every confirmed ending, how to tell which one you got, and the save trick you need.
Before we compare all three endings, look at how Rockstar traps you on that bridge.
title: THE SETUP
subtitle: How Rockstar traps you

narration: The final mission kicks off at Cal's place in the Keys with one last desperate plan.
You have to plug a hard drive into an office computer so Cal's software can decrypt the files.
title: checklist
subtitle: MISSION 91/OBJECTIVE::PLUG THE HARD DRIVE IN|LET CAL'S SOFTWARE DECRYPT IT

narration: You gear up with body armor and frag grenades, then storm a waterfront high-rise under helicopter fire.
title: cards
subtitle: LOADOUT::BODY ARMOR=On|FRAG GRENADES=Ready

narration: Inside, everything goes sideways fast.
Jason gets pinned down in the garage until Lucia fights her way in.
You escape through a construction elevator and race south toward Cal's boat to disappear offshore.
Then the nightmare twist hits: somebody tipped off the cops before you ever reach the docks.
title: TIPPED OFF
subtitle: THE DOCKS ARE BURNED

narration: Forced to improvise, Jason turns toward South Point airfield hoping to steal a getaway plane.
title: THE ESCAPE ROUTE
subtitle: PLAN A=Cal's boat offshore; DOCKS=Cops waiting; PLAN B=South Point airfield; THE BRIDGE=Sealed by sheriffs

narration: That is when the sheriff's department seals the bridge ahead, draining the screen to black and white.
Remember, nothing else in this entire twenty-five-minute mission asks you for a single decision.
title: stats
subtitle: MISSION 91::25 MIN=no other decision|1=the freeze-frame

narration: Everything comes down to this exact freeze-frame, and what happens first if you pull R2.
Let's start with what happens when you pick "No Surrender" by pulling R2 on PlayStation.
title: ENDING 1
subtitle: No Surrender  ·  R2

narration: Jason doesn't even hesitate.
He slams the accelerator straight toward the wall of sheriff cruisers.
The camera drops into brutal slow motion as Lucia stands up inside the car, firing at deputies.
They smash straight through the barricade, veer violently off the road, and slam against the roadside barrier.
When the smoke clears, deputies surround the wreck, and both Jason and Lucia are shot dead in their seats.
It is the classic, heartbreaking Bonnie and Clyde shootout ending that fans predicted for years.
title: BONNIE & CLYDE
subtitle: THE ENDING FANS PREDICTED

narration: Okay, so you reload your save and hit Triangle to "Swim for It" instead, expecting a happy escape.
title: ENDING 2
subtitle: Swim for It  ·  version A

narration: Here is where GTA Six pulls its cruelest trick on unsuspecting players.
"Swim for It" actually has two completely different versions, and your fate is already locked before you press Triangle.
title: cards
subtitle: SWIM FOR IT · TWO VERSIONS::VERSION A=Doomed|VERSION B=Survivor

narration: Listen closely to the very first sentence Jason speaks after you press the button.
If Jason opens with the words "Don't do anything stupid," you are already doomed.
title: quote
subtitle: THE DOOMED LINE::Don't do anything stupid.|Jason|Swim for It · version A

narration: In that version, Jason tells Lucia to let the currents carry them to a sandbar, steal a boat, and head for Cuba.
Deputies scream at him to step out slowly with his hands raised.
Jason steps out with one hand up, except he is still gripping his pistol in the other.
title: checklist
subtitle: THE FATAL MISTAKE::ONE HAND UP|PISTOL STILL IN THE OTHER

narration: The deputies open fire instantly before either of them takes two steps toward the water.
Jason drops dead on the asphalt, Lucia is gunned down in her seat, and nobody makes it out.
So how on earth do you trigger the third ending where both Jason and Lucia actually survive?
In the third confirmed ending, you still press Triangle for "Swim for It" at the bridge.
title: ENDING 3
subtitle: Swim for It  ·  version B

narration: Only this time, listen to Jason's opening line.

He doesn't say "Don't do anything stupid." Instead, Jason looks at Lucia and says four words: "Don't draw your weapon." He pitches the same Cuba sandbar plan, then presses a phone into Lucia's hand saying, "Take this." The screen freezes one more time on a single Triangle prompt reading "Exit." This time, both Jason and Lucia step out completely unarmed with both hands high in the air.
title: quote
subtitle: THE SURVIVOR LINE::Don't draw your weapon.|Jason|Swim for It · version B

narration: While deputies shout for them to hit the ground, they slowly edge sideways and climb onto the bridge wall.
On Jason's count of three, Lucia leaps off the concrete barrier and splashes into the water below.
Before Jason can jump after her, deputies tackle him onto the road and cuff him.
The officers peer over the bridge railing, and Lucia is completely gone.
title: cards
subtitle: ENDING 3 · THE SURVIVOR ENDING::LUCIA=Escaped into the water|JASON=Arrested

narration: She escaped.
Now watch what happens during the credits, because this scene hits like a truck.
First, you see Jason's mugshot at the Vice-Dale Police Department.
title: VICE-DALE PD
subtitle: THE MUGSHOT

narration: Then the scene jumps forward in time to Jason sitting in a prison cell in an orange jumpsuit.
He has long hair and a full beard, quietly reading when a guard calls out: "Hey, Duval.
title: quote
subtitle: THE TIME JUMP::Hey, Duval. Got a visitor.|A guard|The credits

narration: Got a visitor." Jason walks into the visiting room, and sitting behind the glass is a woman holding a toddler.
She calls him "Jay" and smiles, saying one single word: "Surprise." Both Jason and Lucia survived.
title: quote
subtitle: THE VISIT::Surprise.|Lucia, holding a toddler|The credits

narration: He took the fall in prison so she could escape and raise their son.
Now here is the crazy mystery driving the whole GTA community nuts right now: what actually locks this ending?
title: THE FACT-CHECK
subtitle: What unlocks the survivor ending?

narration: Right now, lists all over TikTok and Reddit claim you need four exact things for the survivor ending.
They claim you need two million dollars in BuckMe savings, max romance with Lucia, a Professional Criminal Profile, and to spare a cop.
title: checklist
subtitle: THE VIRAL LIST/TIKTOK + REDDIT::$2M IN BUCKME SAVINGS|MAX ROMANCE WITH LUCIA|PROFESSIONAL CRIMINAL PROFILE|SPARE A COP

narration: Hold on, before you grind two million dollars for nothing, here is the real fact-check.
Guides that checked complete launch playthroughs confirmed there is no "spare the cop" prompt in the final mission.
title: lockout
subtitle: UNVERIFIED::NO SPARE-THE-COP PROMPT|NO SAVINGS CHECK|NO PROFILE POPUP|the list is a guess

narration: No savings check or Criminal Profile popup ever appears onscreen at the roadblock either.
Rockstar did confirm there are "a lot more than two" ending variants shaped by earlier choices across all five chapters.
title: quote
subtitle: ROCKSTAR::A lot more than two ending variants|Shaped by earlier choices|All five chapters

narration: So while something earlier in your save definitely decides Jason's opening line, those exact dollar rules are still unverified guesses.
Now whatever ending you get, do not skip the credits, because there is one more massive scene.
title: DON'T SKIP THE CREDITS
subtitle: Cal's scene  ·  all 3 endings

narration: In all three endings, a post-credits scene cuts back to Cal sitting alone at his place in the Keys.
He has been waiting all day for that stolen hard drive to finish decrypting.
Late at night, the files finally unlock, and the look on Cal's face screams something huge is on that drive.
Right after that, the secret Gold Trophy "You Gotta Know When to Get Off" pops for fifty Gamerscore.
title: cards
subtitle: SECRET GOLD TROPHY::YOU GOTTA KNOW WHEN TO GET OFF=50 Gamerscore

narration: And then Rockstar drops the weirdest post-game twist in GTA history.
Instead of continuing after prison or death, the Story Complete screen rewinds you back before the finale.
title: STORY COMPLETE
subtitle: REWINDS TO BEFORE THE FINALE

narration: Jason and Lucia literally decide they aren't ready yet and head back out into Vice City.
So if you are about to start The End of the Road, do not rely on the single autosave.
title: THE SAVE TRICK
subtitle: Before Mission 91

narration: Drop a dedicated manual save in a fresh slot right before walking into Cal's place in the Keys.
Remember, Rockstar removed Mission Replay, so that manual save is your fastest way to see both bridge prompts.
title: lockout
subtitle: NO MISSION REPLAY::REPLAY THE FINALE|PICK THE OTHER PROMPT|your manual save does it

narration: Play through once, watch Cal's post-credits scene, unlock your sixty-one cheat codes, then reload to test the other choice.
title: checklist
subtitle: THE PLAN::1  PLAY ONCE + WATCH CAL|2  UNLOCK YOUR 61 CHEATS|3  RELOAD, TRY THE OTHER PROMPT
